hunt.justification: AI-powered social engineering lures are a primary vector for modern ransomware. Catching the initial execution and verifying subsequent impact before encryption completes protects business continuity and limits data loss.

meta.analysis: A standard rule might flag shells spawned from browsers, but it cannot weigh that lead against real-world impact metrics like the volume of exfiltrated bytes and the count of modified files. This hunt uses a gated flow to confirm intent before escalating to expensive stateful analysis.

scenario.summary: In 2026, attackers are increasingly leveraging AI-powered phishing and the hijacking of trusted RMM tools like ScreenConnect to establish stealthy persistence. These campaigns often transition to identity-centric attacks, bypassing MFA via session theft and manipulating cloud environments through BEC flows, ultimately culminating in data exfiltration and multi-extortion ransomware.

meta.rationale: The analyst starts with servers and workstations running ScreenConnect; they widen the scope to all endpoints if they suspect AI social engineering activity fleet-wide.
meta.hypothesis: An adversary uses an AI-crafted social engineering lure to execute a loader that performs data staging or ransomware encryption.

hunt.name: AI Social Engineering and Ransomware Operations
hunt.description: This hunt identifies social engineering lures that bypass traditional filters. The hunt identifies hosts with remote management tools, then queries for browsers spawning interpreters. The hunt gates expensive queries into data staging and exfiltration only when the agent confirms a suspicious foothold, allowing the analyst to weigh the initial execution against subsequent volumes of file and network activity.

config.scoping_notes: The analyst starts with servers and workstations running ScreenConnect; they widen the scope to all endpoints if they suspect AI social engineering activity fleet-wide.
config.beyond_detection: A standard rule might flag shells spawned from browsers, but it cannot weigh that lead against real-world impact metrics like the volume of exfiltrated bytes and the count of modified files. This hunt uses a gated flow to confirm intent before escalating to expensive stateful analysis.

config.content: SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE instr(',' || '{{target_rmm_vendors}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(vendor_name) || ',') > 0 OR instr(',' || '{{target_rmm_vendors}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(package_name) || ',') > 0
config.description: The hunt finds the hosts running RMM software like ScreenConnect that are high-priority targets for platform hijacking and lateral movement.
config.expected_signal: A list of hosts running ConnectWise or ScreenConnect software. Silence means no such RMM software is installed via managed package managers.

primitive_config.label: Identify hosts with RMM tools
primitive_config.content: SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE instr(',' || '{{target_rmm_vendors}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(vendor_name) || ',') > 0 OR instr(',' || '{{target_rmm_vendors}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(package_name) || ',') > 0
primitive_config.expected: A list of hosts running ConnectWise or ScreenConnect software. Silence means no such RMM software is installed via managed package managers.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_cmd_line, parent_process_name, user_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND instr(',' || '{{browser_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(parent_process_name) || ',') > 0 AND instr(',' || '{{shell_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: The hunt finds the initial execution of an AI-powered social engineering lure where a browser launches a system shell.
config.expected_signal: A shell process whose parent is a common web browser. Silence means no direct shell execution from browsers was observed in this window.

primitive_config.label: Browser-spawned shell or interpreter
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_cmd_line, parent_process_name, user_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND instr(',' || '{{browser_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(parent_process_name) || ',') > 0 AND instr(',' || '{{shell_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: A shell process whose parent is a common web browser. Silence means no direct shell execution from browsers was observed in this window.

config.objective: Decide if the command lines in browser-spawned-shell-lead represent a social engineering lure or loader foothold.
config.description: The agent assesses whether the browser-spawned activity looks like a malicious lure (e.g., encoded commands or web downloads) to avoid expensive impact queries on benign activity.
config.expected_signal: A per-host verdict of malicious, suspicious, or benign.
config.success_criteria: A clear verdict for every host cited.

config.question: the gate-agent verdict is suspicious or malicious for at least one host
config.condition: the gate-agent verdict is suspicious or malicious for at least one host
config.description: The hunt routes execution to impact queries only if the agent finds a suspicious foothold.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, dst_endpoint_ip, SUM(traffic_bytes) as total_bytes, COUNT(*) as connection_count FROM hb_network_connection WHERE direction = 'outbound' AND state_kind = 'log' AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, process_name, dst_endpoint_ip HAVING total_bytes > {{exfil_byte_threshold}} ORDER BY total_bytes DESC
config.description: The hunt detects potential exfiltration by finding processes sending unusually large amounts of data to external IPs.
config.expected_signal: A host sending >50MB to a single destination. Silence suggests no high-volume exfiltration occurred via tracked network flows.

primitive_config.label: High-volume outbound exfiltration
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, dst_endpoint_ip, SUM(traffic_bytes) as total_bytes, COUNT(*) as connection_count FROM hb_network_connection WHERE direction = 'outbound' AND state_kind = 'log' AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, process_name, dst_endpoint_ip HAVING total_bytes > {{exfil_byte_threshold}} ORDER BY total_bytes DESC
primitive_config.expected: A host sending >50MB to a single destination. Silence suggests no high-volume exfiltration occurred via tracked network flows.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, COUNT(DISTINCT file_path) as file_count FROM hb_file_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND activity_name IN ('Create', 'Update', 'Rename', 'Delete') AND (LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%\\users\\%' OR LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%\\appdata\\%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, process_name HAVING file_count > {{file_threshold}} ORDER BY file_count DESC
config.description: The hunt identifies potential ransomware encryption by counting file modifications in user-writable paths.
config.expected_signal: A single process modifying hundreds of files. Silence means no large-scale file manipulation was observed.

primitive_config.label: Rapid file modification
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, COUNT(DISTINCT file_path) as file_count FROM hb_file_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND activity_name IN ('Create', 'Update', 'Rename', 'Delete') AND (LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%\\users\\%' OR LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%\\appdata\\%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, process_name HAVING file_count > {{file_threshold}} ORDER BY file_count DESC
primitive_config.expected: A single process modifying hundreds of files. Silence means no large-scale file manipulation was observed.

config.objective: Determine if the suspicion from gate-agent is confirmed by the high-volume activity in exfiltration-activity or encryption-activity.
config.description: The agent weighs the initial lure execution against subsequent impact to confirm a ransomware operation.
config.expected_signal: A high-confidence verdict linking phish to impact.
config.success_criteria: A final verdict citing specific rows and volumes of data/files.

config.question: the final-triage verdict is malicious and confirms either high-volume file modification or high-volume outbound network traffic
config.condition: the final-triage verdict is malicious and confirms either high-volume file modification or high-volume outbound network traffic
config.description: The hunt triggers containment if the agent confirms impact.
The hunt stops encryption and data theft immediately.
config.instructions: Isolate the host immediately. Coordinate with the SOC to collect the binary for forensic analysis.

config.description: The analyst confirms the operation and prepares a report.
config.instructions: Review the cited rows from final-triage. Verify the process lineage and confirm if the outbound traffic was to a known C2 or storage provider.

config.description: The analyst records findings for non-malicious runs.
config.instructions: Record that browser activity was reviewed and found benign. No evidence of social engineering lures or subsequent impact was observed.
